title: Microcharge decomposition pipeline for per-route/model/customer analytics
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Console needs a low-latency, auditable decomposition of billing and latency by route, model, and customer across hosted and dedicated deployments. Existing rollups are hourly and conflate multi-model responses; product wants near-real-time per-route visibility for SLA and cost optimization, and finance needs deterministic mapping back to the billing ledger.

Goal: Build a hybrid streaming+batch pipeline that attributes token-level cost and per-request latency to route/model/customer with configurable attribution strategies (token-proportional, model-priority, prefix-aware). Provide both a streaming materialized view for Console recent queries (<= 2s staleness) and a reconciled batch table for month-end accounting that is provably consistent with the billing ledger.

Constraints and non-goals: This ticket focuses on the decomposition service and the data pipeline; it does not alter the billing invoice format or tariff definitions. We must avoid double-counting for multi-model fan-out responses and preserve customer PII separation for Private deployments. CPU/GPU cost estimates should be merged from infra telemetry; if unavailable, fall back to kernel-cost heuristics.
acceptance_criteria: Streaming materialized view exposes per-route/model/customer cost and latency for last 24h with <=2s eventual consistency for Console queries
Batch reconciliation job produces month-to-date tables that reconcile with the billing ledger within 0.5% margin and records reconciliation diffs
Attribution strategies supported: token-proportional, model-priority, and prefix-anchored; selectable per-route via config API
End-to-end tests that simulate multi-model fan-out requests and validate no double-counting
Console dashboards updated with new per-route breakdown widgets and alerting on >5% daily regression against baseline
Performance: streaming cost does not increase average inference path latency by more than 5% and pipeline adds <15% to operational cost at 1x production traffic
tasks: Design spec for decomposition pipeline and attribution algorithms (link in links)
Implement streaming collector: enrich inference trace with token-level metrics and model tags (Kafka topic: route-telemetry-v2)
Build Flink streaming job to perform online attribution and write to ClickHouse materialized tables for Console
Create hourly Spark batch job to reconcile streaming aggregates against canonical billing ledger in BigQuery
Implement config API to set attribution strategy per route and expose via Console
Add unit + integration tests that mock multi-model flows and KV-cache reuse across requests
Create migration for legacy hourly rollups to the new schema and run backfill for 90 days
Add Grafana dashboards, SLOs, and alerting for pipeline lag, reconciliation drift, and stream errors
Document operator runbooks and security considerations for Private deployments (KMS/HSM key access)
Submit PR, run canary on staging, and iterate on perf regressions
comments: 2026-03-01: Initial design reviewed with PM and Console team. PM asked for a config per-route to pick attribution strategy; added to tasks. (Maya Chen)

2026-03-03: Engineering spike showed Kafka message size growth when emitting token-level deltas. Decided to compress payload and emit only deltas + sampled token traces for long outputs. Trade-off: sampling reduces granularity for very long requests but keeps throughput manageable. (Arjun Patel)

2026-03-05: Prototype Flink job can apply token-proportional attribution in streaming; discovered concurrency ordering issues with KV cache hits resulting in attribution duplication. Next step: add request-scoped dedupe key and idempotent sink to ClickHouse. (Arjun Patel)

2026-03-08: Finance reviewed acceptance criteria; requested monthly reconciliation within 0.5%. We added a batch Spark job that recomputes cost from canonical billing events in BigQuery and emits reconciliation deltas. (Lena Morales, Finance)

2026-03-10: Security scoping: Private deployments cannot send telemetry to hosted Kafka. Plan: enable local sharded collectors writing to customer-owned S3 and run the same Flink logic in a private AZ. Need security review for credentials rotation. (Priya Rao, Security)
2026-03-11: PR #4620 opened for collector schema changes and Kafka topic; staged in 'telemetry-qa' cluster. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4620 (Arjun Patel)
review_feedback: PM: Please ensure Console supports toggling attribution view per-customer in addition to per-route. Added to spec. (Samir Gupta)
Design: Widget needs to show both absolute cost and normalized cost per-1000 tokens. Keep UI changes minimal for first rollout. (Nina Ortiz)
SRE: Ensure streaming job uses exactly-once sinks and circuit-breaker for ClickHouse in degradation mode. Also add backpressure metrics and alerting. (Riley O'Connor)
Finance: For the batch reconciliation, include kernel-level GPU time estimate source and mark when estimate was used. (Lena Morales)
